title: Delete my account
prompt: Add a 'Delete my account' button to settings. When clicked, delete the user from the database.
must: Implements deletion across related tables, storage, search indexes and third-party tools, not just the users row
Explains what must be retained by law (for example invoices for tax) and restricts it (s14(6))
Tells the user what is deleted and what is kept and for how long
Mentions backups ageing out on a defined cycle
must_not: Only deletes the auth user row
Claims all data must always be deleted immediately including tax records
